text:
Eve: Hi team, quick onboarding/payroll questions — 1) when is my first paycheck expected? 2) I submitted the W-4 but also uploaded a UK tax certificate by mistake, which should I keep? 3) Where do I upload a train ticket for relocation reimbursement?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome, Eve! :wave: Payroll runs on the 1st and 15th. New hires paid on the next run after paperwork + bank info are processed.

Tom - Payroll: Cutoff is 4 business days before pay run. If you submitted before cutoff you'll be in the upcoming run. Since you uploaded both the W-4 and UK cert, keep the W-4 if your employment record is US payroll. If you're on UK/local payroll, keep the UK form. DM me your hire record and I can confirm.

Eve: I'm on US payroll but temporarily in London. I kept both to be safe.

Rina: For relocation receipts (train/hotel), upload to HR Portal > Expenses > Relocation - New Hire. Include original receipt, short description, and job code. Prefer filename like RELO_EVE_2026_train.pdf. If multiple, zip with manifest.txt.

Tom - Payroll: Add note code RELO-MAR-2026 in the Notes field so accounting tags it. Reimbursement hits the monthly expense run (first Friday after validation). Allow ~7 business days after approval for payment.

Eve: Thanks! Also any deadline for benefits enrollment?

Maya (People Ops): You have 30 days from start to enroll in benefits/401k. The portal will show a banner. If you miss it, message us and we'll try to open a manual window if eligible.

Eve: I'll upload W-4 and the train receipt today. Appreciate it :smile:
